title: Physical proximity IS authentication. USB hub travels. HSMs accumulate at home.

the_vision.principle: Touch ONCE = trust FOREVER. Single proximity starts the reveal.
the_vision.how: Kevin carries SoloKey + Pixel + iPhone. Each gate gets physically touched. Over time ALL gates have been enrolled by ALL devices.
the_vision.endgame: ANY registered device approaching from a distance begins the reveal. The HSMs at home verify. No cloud. No password. Presence IS proof.

usb_hub_protocol.what: USB hub with ADB cables travels between gates
steps: 3. Run enrollment ceremony (beardog key generate per device)
4. Gate stores device fingerprints in local HSM / beardog keyring
5. Unplug hub, move to next gate
6. Repeat until ALL gates know ALL devices
usb_hub_protocol.result: Every gate has enrolled every portable device. Trust web is COMPLETE.
usb_hub_protocol.can_disable_locks_after: Once all gates are enrolled, no more manual ceremony needed

proximity_reveal.principle: DISTANCE = LATENCY = TRUST LEVEL. Closer = faster = more trust. All protocols already exist on all devices.
proximity_reveal.note: USB enrollment is PERMANENT (one-time ceremony). Everything else is EPHEMERAL — come and go. Presence detected, absence detected. No session. No login.

touch.note: This is the ONE permanent ceremony. Everything else flows from this.

room.trust: PROTON — in the room, breathing the same air
room.status: READY — every gate and phone has Bluetooth. Just turn it on.
room.note: BLE advertisement = presence. No pairing needed. Phone in pocket = gate knows. Headset = audio stream = proof of proximity.

house.trust: PROTON — home. Both houses connected via 10G fiber.
house.status: READY — Aperture Science = IoT, Black Mesa = streaming. grapheneGate already connected.
house.note: Phone joins home WiFi → ARP table updates → all gates know you're home. Move between houses = fiber carries the signal.

neighborhood.status: POSSIBLE — phone can ping home over cellular
neighborhood.note: Walking to mailbox, in the yard, at neighbor's. Signal weakens but still present.

world.trust: ELECTRON — remote. Latency IS the proof of distance.
world.note: WiFi from other side of world = bad latency = NOT proximity. The latency IS the distance measurement. 500ms = far away.

hsm_accumulation.principle: HSMs stay HOME. Portable devices TRAVEL. Trust accumulates.

at_home.graftGate: Apple M4 Secure Enclave + Neural Engine

traveling.SoloKey: carries the root of trust physically
traveling.Pixel: Titan M2 — mobile HSM that touches each gate

hsm_accumulation.analogy: T-cells (phones) travel through the body (LAN), touching every organ (gate). Each organ learns the T-cell. Eventually the BODY recognizes the cell instantly from any distance (WiFi/BLE proximity).

house_2_expansion.protocol: Same USB hub, same devices, same ceremony
house_2_expansion.vision: Kevin walks between houses. Both houses recognize him.
